title: 三星电子利润暴增19倍股价反跌8%市场在担忧什么
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Our top story today, the AI trade revival on Wall Street proves to be shot-lived, as tech stocks in Asia under renewed selling pressure, investors in the region increasingly
segments.zh: 今日头条：华尔街AI交易复苏昙花一现，亚洲科技股再遭抛售，市场参与者正转向其他板块。

segments.en: rotating out of tech and into other sectors as they reassess the outlook.
segments.zh: 市场参与者重新评估前景，从科技股转向其他板块。

segments.en: Chip Giants Samsung failed to impress investors even after its preliminary results showed a 19-fold surge in quarterly profit. The sell-off suggests that investors
segments.zh: 芯片巨头三星初步业绩显示季度利润飙升19倍，但未能打动市场参与者，抛售表明市场已消化利好。

segments.en: already priced in the solid earnings and are focused on the longer-term memory cycle trajectory.
segments.zh: 市场关注长期内存周期走势。

segments.en: Let's get more from Ray Wong, founder and principal analyst at Constellation Research.
segments.zh: 请来Constellation Research创始人Ray Wong分析。

segments.en: It is the Silicon Valley-based advisory firm. Ray could have you with us. I mean, break down the numbers for us. Is there any reason for markets to be disappointed? The stocks are
segments.zh: Ray，请解读数据，市场为何失望？股价下跌8%。

segments.en: down 8%. You know, it's a great point. I mean, people are worried about the highs.
segments.zh: 好问题，市场担忧预期过高。

segments.en: Expectations have been pretty high along the way, but the overall demand for high-band memory, the overall demand for DRAM is still there. We're talking about 18 to 24-month backlog.
segments.zh: 但高带宽内存和DRAM需求依然强劲，订单积压18-24个月。

segments.en: The supply is huge. You cannot do AI without memory, and especially on the high-band with memory, and especially on the DRAM, you can't possibly miss this. I mean, the Cosby has been super volatile.
segments.zh: 供应巨大，没有内存就无法做AI，尤其是高带宽内存和DRAM。

segments.en: If you look at Samsung stock at some point, it was up 165% for a year to date. It's been a great run, and the expectations to have an 18X increase, I mean, 56 billion. This is stellar numbers.
segments.zh: 三星股价一度年内涨165%，预期利润增18倍至560亿，业绩亮眼。
